name: Tavily Search
summary: Search built for AI agents: results come back as short content snippets ready for a prompt. 1,000 free credits every month without a card; a basic search costs 1 credit.

allowance.text: 1,000 free API credits every month, no credit card required

rate_limits.note: Development keys: 100 requests a minute. Production keys (1,000 a minute) need a paid plan or pay-as-you-go.

usage_terms_note: The free plan gives Development keys; Production keys need a paid plan or pay-as-you-go. Tavily's terms of service haven't been checked yet.
data_logging_note: Tavily may use parts of your query data to improve its responses to future queries, and may send queries to third-party search indexes (such as Google) when its own index can't answer.

locale.note: Both boost matching results rather than filter; add "filter_by_language": true to filter by language. country works with topic "general" only.
